## Selected Case Studies

### 1. agent-setup
- Repository: https://github.com/whysooraj/agent-setup
- Description: Deterministic, idempotent environment installer and CLI bootstrapped for Linux and macOS.
- Core Problem: Developers losing hours debugging environment inconsistencies and corrupted dotfiles on fresh installs.
- Solution: Pre-flight environment probing, strict idempotency, safe atomic link creation, zero-dependency bash architecture.

### 2. branch-prediction-sim
- Repository: https://github.com/whysooraj
- Description: Interactive hardware architectural simulator modeling speculative CPU execution.
- Features: 2-bit saturating counters, Branch History Table (BHT), Branch Target Buffer (BTB), cycle-accurate stall accumulation.

### 3. quanevac
- Repository: https://github.com/whysooraj/quanevac
- Description: Quantum evacuation and pathfinding simulation engine.
- Constraints: Classical memory limits during state-vector expansion; state space pruning and matrix bounding.
